archipelago.title: Programmier-Archipel
archipelago.subtitle: Discover the world of programming
archipelago.minecraftBlockCodingDesc: Learn block coding fundamentals with Minecraft Education
archipelago.minecraftAdvancedDesc: Advanced programming concepts in Minecraft Education
archipelago.lesson1sub: Movement, orientation and coordinates in Minecraft Education
archipelago.lesson1desc: Before we start with block coding and Agents, you'll learn the essential controls in Minecraft Education. Move safely through the world, overcome obstacles, and navigate using coordinates and landmarks.
archipelago.lesson1preview: After this lesson, you can move safely and orient yourself in Minecraft Education. These skills form the foundation for all further coding adventures on the archipelago.

lesson1tasks.title: Color Course
lesson1tasks.description: Follow colored wool paths and overcome obstacles.

lesson1tasks.title: Treasure Hunt
lesson1tasks.description: Find hidden items using directions and coordinates.

archipelago.lesson1rewardDesc: For successfully completing the first journey across the island.
archipelago.lesson1conclusion: You can now move safely and orient yourself in Minecraft Education. These skills form the foundation for all further coding adventures on the archipelago.
archipelago.lesson2desc: In this lesson, you'll learn the basics of block coding. Discover how programs are built from individual commands and how Minecraft responds to your blocks.
archipelago.lesson2preview: You've taken your first steps in block coding and now know how programs are built from individual commands.

lesson2tasks.title: My First Program
lesson2tasks.description: Create a simple program with 5 commands.

lesson2tasks.title: Lay a Pattern
lesson2tasks.description: Create a simple pattern with different blocks.

lesson2tasks.title: Find the Bug
lesson2tasks.description: Find and fix the error in a given program.

archipelago.lesson2rewardDesc: For the first successful steps in block coding.
archipelago.lesson2conclusion: You've taken your first steps in block coding and now know how programs are built from individual commands.
archipelago.lesson3: The Agent and Its First Commands
archipelago.lesson3desc: Meet your first programmable helper - the Agent. Discover how to give it commands and how it places and moves blocks in the world.
archipelago.lesson3preview: You've met your first programmable helper and can now give it your own commands.
archipelago.lesson4desc: Learn to move the Agent through the Minecraft world with purpose. Understand directions, combine commands, and plan simple routes.
archipelago.lesson4preview: You can now steer the Agent through the world and solve simple navigation tasks.
archipelago.lesson5desc: The Agent becomes a builder. Learn the first building commands to place blocks automatically and create simple structures.
lesson5objectives: Use the Agent as a builder
archipelago.lesson5preview: You've learned how the Agent can place blocks and take on building tasks. This is the beginning of automated building.
archipelago.lesson6desc: Learn how to use loops to automatically repeat commands. The Agent performs tasks multiple times without you having to write the code over and over.
archipelago.lesson6preview: You've learned how programs can automatically repeat tasks. This saves time and makes larger projects easier.
archipelago.lesson7desc: Programs make decisions. The Agent learns to react differently depending on a situation or condition.
archipelago.lesson7preview: You've learned how programs make decisions. This makes your Agent much smarter and able to react to its environment.
archipelago.lesson8desc: Programs can react to events. The Agent and Minecraft should perform actions when a specific trigger occurs or a chat command is used.
archipelago.lesson8preview: You've learned how programs react to events. This makes your projects interactive and able to respond to player input.
archipelago.lesson9desc: Programs can remember information. With variables, you can store, change, and reuse values later.
archipelago.lesson9preview: You've learned how programs can store and reuse information. This makes your projects much more powerful.
archipelago.lesson10desc: Use everything you've learned so far. Plan your own project and combine skills from previous lessons.
archipelago.lesson10preview: You've almost completed the Minecraft Education Block Coding archipelago. Only the mysterious final island lies ahead.

lesson3tasks.title: Start the Agent
lesson3tasks.description: Spawn the Agent and give it three simple commands.

lesson3tasks.title: Build a Path
lesson3tasks.description: Create a path of 5 blocks with the Agent.

lesson3tasks.title: Change Direction
lesson3tasks.description: Make the Agent change direction and continue building.

lesson3knowledge: Agent - A programmable robot in Minecraft
Command - A single instruction for the Agent
Execution - The order in which commands are carried out
Movement - Moving the Agent in a direction
archipelago.lesson3rewardDesc: You've successfully controlled your first Agent.
archipelago.lesson3conclusion: You've met your first programmable helper and can now give it your own commands.

lesson4tasks.title: Straight Path
lesson4tasks.description: Make the Agent walk 6 steps forward.

lesson4tasks.title: Walk a Rectangle
lesson4tasks.description: Make the Agent walk a rectangle path.

lesson4tasks.title: Go Around Obstacle
lesson4tasks.description: Navigate the Agent around a wall.

lesson4knowledge: Direction - The compass direction the Agent faces
Forward - The Agent moves in the direction it is facing
Backward - The Agent moves opposite to its facing direction
Turning - Rotating the Agent left or right without moving
Navigation - Planning and executing movement sequences
archipelago.lesson4rewardDesc: For successfully navigating the Agent through its first challenges.
archipelago.lesson4conclusion: You can now steer the Agent through the world and solve simple navigation tasks.

lesson5tasks.title: First Wall
lesson5tasks.description: Build a wall of 5 stone blocks with the Agent.

lesson5tasks.title: Colorful Path
lesson5tasks.description: Create a path from 4 different blocks.

lesson5tasks.title: Build Stairs
lesson5tasks.description: Build a simple staircase with 3 steps.

lesson5knowledge: Placing - The Agent puts a block into the world
Block - A building block in Minecraft
Building - Creating structures by placing blocks
Building task - An assignment for the Agent

lesson5challenge.title: Builder Challenge
lesson5challenge.description: Create a small building project with the Agent – for example a simple house or a straight path.

archipelago.lesson5rewardDesc: For successfully using the first building commands.
archipelago.lesson5conclusion: You've learned how the Agent can place blocks and take on building tasks. This is the beginning of automated building.

lesson6tasks.title: First Loop
lesson6tasks.description: Build a wall of 8 stone blocks using a loop.

lesson6tasks.title: Colorful Path
lesson6tasks.description: Create a path of 6 grass blocks using a loop.

lesson6tasks.title: Rectangle with Loops
lesson6tasks.description: Build a rectangle using 4 loops for the 4 sides.

lesson6knowledge: Loop - A block that repeats commands
Repetition - Executing a command multiple times
Flow - The order of command execution
Automation - Tasks repeated by the computer

lesson6mission.title: Avoid Infinite Loops
lesson6mission.description: Avoid infinite loops! Start with small numbers and test step by step.

archipelago.lesson6rewardDesc: You've successfully harnessed the power of repetition.
archipelago.lesson6conclusion: You've learned how programs can automatically repeat tasks. This saves time and makes larger projects easier.

lesson7tasks.title: Detect Obstacle
lesson7tasks.description: Check if the Agent can move forward.

lesson7tasks.title: Check Block
lesson7tasks.description: Check if there is a grass block at a position.

lesson7tasks.title: Decision Tree
lesson7tasks.description: Create a flow with 2 consecutive conditions.

lesson7knowledge: Condition - A question with yes/no answer
Decision - The program chooses different actions
If - Only runs code when true
Then - The code that runs when true
True / False - The two answers of a condition

lesson7mission.title: The Clever Agent
lesson7mission.description: Use conditions and experience how the Agent performs different actions depending on the situation.

archipelago.lesson7rewardDesc: You've successfully programmed your first decisions.
archipelago.lesson7conclusion: You've learned how programs make decisions. This makes your Agent much smarter and able to react to its environment.

lesson8tasks.title: First Chat Command
lesson8tasks.description: Create a program that reacts to /start.

lesson8tasks.title: Build with Command
lesson8tasks.description: Create the chat command /bridge for the Agent.

lesson8knowledge: Chat Command - A command in chat (often with /)
Reaction - What the Agent does in response

lesson8mission.title: The Magic Voice Command
lesson8mission.description: Experience how a chat command automatically triggers actions.

archipelago.lesson8rewardDesc: You've successfully controlled programs with events and chat commands.
archipelago.lesson8conclusion: You've learned how programs react to events. This makes your projects interactive and able to respond to player input.
lesson9knowledge: Variable - A named box for storing values
Value - What is stored in the variable
Store - Putting a value in a variable
Data - Information used by a program
Information - Everything the program needs to remember

lesson9mission.title: The Memory Agent
lesson9mission.description: Program the Agent to remember a number, increase it with each step, and output it at the end.

archipelago.lesson9rewardDesc: You've successfully learned to store and manage information with variables.
archipelago.lesson9conclusion: You've learned how programs can store and reuse information. This makes your projects much more powerful.

lesson10tasks.title: Project Phase 2: Implementation
lesson10tasks.description: Build your project step by step.

lesson10tasks.title: Project Phase 3: Presentation
lesson10tasks.description: Present your project to the class.

lesson10mission.title: The Road to the Last Island
lesson10mission.description: Use all skills from previous islands for the final challenge.

archipelago.lesson10rewardDesc: You've completed all training islands successfully and are ready for the final journey.
archipelago.lesson10conclusion: You've almost completed the Minecraft Education Block Coding archipelago. Only the mysterious final island lies ahead.
archipelago.lesson11desc: This island is still locked. Collect all skills from the previous islands to enter it.
